items.title: Jaws
items.line: Opened on 20 June 1975 on 464 screens, made a record $7 million on its first weekend, and was the highest-grossing film ever until Star Wars.

items.title: Altair 8800
items.line: The January 1975 Popular Electronics cover sold a $439 computer kit from MITS in Albuquerque. Bill Gates and Paul Allen wrote its BASIC and started Microsoft on it.

items.title: The fall of Saigon
items.line: Saigon fell on 30 April 1975, and helicopters lifted about 7,000 people out of the city in the last two days.

items.title: Saturday Night Live
items.line: NBC's Saturday Night went out for the first time on 11 October 1975, with George Carlin hosting and Billy Preston and Janis Ian playing.

items.title: Betamax
items.line: Sony launched Betamax in Japan on 10 May 1975; the first US model, built into a 19-inch Trinitron, reached shops that November.

items.title: Fleetwood Mac
items.line: The first album with Lindsey Buckingham and Stevie Nicks came out on 11 July 1975, recorded at Sound City in Van Nuys, and took over a year to reach number 1.
